notes:
# New

### Bazaar
* Added "Put On Bazaar" actions to both Inventory and Library views, allowing you to put one or multiple items on your bazaar.
* Items in the bazaar now show with a visual indicator in both views.
* Added a "Max All" function which maxes out all stackable items when buying multiple items from another player's Bazaar.

### Inventory
* Multi-select now works when searching items in "All Characters" view.
* Added a "Large Item Popups" setting in Settings which creates full sized tooltips in Inventory view.

### Library
* Filters now additionally hide empty bags and characters.

### Storage NPC
* Added SP Gobbie Key to all Mystery Box goblins. Use a set amount or use all (up to however much free slots you have in your inventory)

# Bugfixes
* Fixed an issue where the pop-out Treasure Pool ui was resetting both position and size when restarted.
* Fixed a bug where Lootblox was not trading the proper amount of Ordelle Bronzepieces to exchange for Montiont Silverpiece.
* Fixed a bug where Inventory and Library sort order did not persist across sessions.
